x: Javelin Throw · 62.94m · Mark Francis · Sutton & District AC · E · Tooting Bec · 20 Aug 1997

The 100 metres clash between Belgrave sprint titans Darren Campbell (European Champion) and Dwain Chambers (World Championships Bronze Medallist) with 17 year-old Mark Lewis Francis (Birchfield) and Jason Gardner (Bath) also vying for the top slot, fully lived up to expectations.
And as if it was expected that we might be in trouble, the cavalry arrived in the form of Tim Benjamin and Mark Lewis Francis, roaring into the car park on quad bikes – and expecting to train.
